opening.argument: The speaker presents Forsage participation as an income route built around invitations and specified program contributions. The marketing plan refers to a "matrix of X4," links occupying multiple slots to income because "the maximum he will get income in both slots," and promises participants, "You will get overspill." These statements describe a bottom-to-top distribution mechanism using ponzi or pyramid terminology. Calls for honesty do not establish the basis of those income and distribution claims, while the separate sponsored miner advertisement has no established connection to the meeting.
